format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this tileset, like "meadow". It matches the file name.

image.description: The picture every tile is cut from, as a path inside the game, like art/tiles.png.

tileSize.description: One tile's side in the picture, in pixels.

columns.description: How many tiles wide the picture is.

id.description: A name for this kind of tile, like "grass".

letter.description: The letter a level uses for this tile in its rows, like "G".

solid.description: True if things stand on this tile and bump into it, false if they pass through.

frame.description: Which square of the picture to draw, counted left to right and top to bottom from 0.

when.description: What the neighbours must be for this picture to be drawn. Left out means always. The last picture has none.

up.description: "same" if the tile above is this kind of tile, "other" if not.

down.description: "same" if the tile below is this kind of tile, "other" if not.

left.description: "same" if the tile on the left is this kind of tile, "other" if not.

right.description: "same" if the tile on the right is this kind of tile, "other" if not.

pictures.description: How the tile looks. The first picture whose "when" fits is drawn; the last is the one drawn otherwise.

tiles.description: Every kind of tile this tileset has.
